new.question: artifact_root computation: how the root of a registration's artifact closure is computed for each closure kind (native, python, packaged).
new.ch0_fixes: Closure kinds are native (executable SHA-256), python (script SHA-256 plus interpreter identity plus dependency lock identity) and packaged (manifest root or image digest) (registrations.json); bound closures stay in the content store while any non-terminal record binds them (INV-58).
new.open: What goes into a closure is U-18's question; how its root is computed from those bytes is this one's.

new.question: Your two recordless decisions: t-s13 (your budget grant or attestation, cap-47) and t-c06 (your rejection, cap-02) neither require nor mint a record, unlike every other transition you trigger. Is each recorded as configuration, in the journal (obj-36), or as an authority record?
new.ch0_fixes: Every other transition you trigger requires or mints a record: t-c05 mints obj-04, t-d01 mints obj-01, w-s01 requires obj-01, w-s02 and w-s03 require obj-38, t-i07 requires obj-37, and t-o04 and t-o05 require obj-34; every transition is written to the journal (ARCHITECTURE §15); budgets are your caps (cap-47), and operational config is excluded from every tier (identity.json).
new.open: Chapter 0 may intend budget grants as configuration. A new authority record type, or a new kind of an existing one, would need a Chapter 0 correction; a journal entry would not. obj-37's kinds are ASSERTION and EFFECT_OUTCOME, so t-s13's attestation is neither.
